resources.string: The original is retained. First use downloads models and may use mobile data. Translation and caching run on device. Choose the source language.

Due searches are checked on app launch after 6 hours, or manually. Up to 10 searches are checked per launch; manual checks include all. Only the first page of each query is checked. The first success establishes a baseline; later matches are newly discovered, not necessarily newly uploaded. Stored on this device only; not included in backup or sync yet.
No saved searches. Run a search, then save its criteria.
Waiting for the first successful baseline check
Check failed; previous records are retained. Retry after checking the site/network or completing verification on the search page.
Delete this saved search and its discoveries? Videos and other searches are retained.
Saved search data cannot be read. Original data is retained and writes are blocked. Reopen this list after repairing the data.
